title: STILLWATER CUT
heading: STILLWATER CUT
BOOTLEG WORKS
intro: STOP THE CUTTING FEED AND DIVERT THE COPPER CONDENSER.

stations.label: SLIDE THE SCALE DRAWER
stations.message: CACHE UNLATCHED. THE SCALE HOUSE KEEPS TWO SETS OF BOOKS.

stations.label: DISENGAGE THE CUTTING FEED
stations.message: CUTTING FEED OFF. BENCH SHUTTER OPEN.

stations.label: LIFT THE CART LATCH
stations.message: OPEN CUT TO THE BOTTLE WASH.

stations.label: DIVERT THE COPPER CONDENSER
stations.message: PRESSURE DIVERTED. TAKE THE RECOVERY GATE.

stations.label: VENT THE BOTTLING RELAY
stations.message: COPPER BARON! USE THE RELIEF VALVES.

stations.label: OPEN WEST RELIEF VALVE
stations.message: RELIEF OPEN. FEWER OUTLETS UNDER PRESSURE.

stations.label: OPEN EAST RELIEF VALVE
stations.message: RELIEF OPEN. FEWER OUTLETS UNDER PRESSURE.

notes: BLUE TRUNK / ONE HOG TAG AND SIX EMPTY JUGS. BILL THE SHERIFF.

quarry-cut-leak: COPPER JOINT WHISTLES. GIVE IT ROOM.

do.message: THE PIT ECHOES. EVERYTHING DOWN HERE HEARD YOU.
FIRE IN THE HOLE! SOMEBODY LIT A FUSE.
